all_rounder.desc: A complete footballer's toolkit: decent on the ball, sharp off the pitch, and strong in the gym.

lower_quests.description: Down a bottle of water like a player at the water break and knock out 5 bodyweight squats to fire up your legs for the day.
Tidy your kit (okay, your desk) for 60 seconds, then read one page about the game, tactics, or anything football-adjacent.
Set today's match plan by writing your primary goal, then bang out 3 push-ups like you're warming up in the tunnel.
Sprint through a 60-second typing drill for quick feet on the keyboard, then get the blood flowing with 10 jumping jacks.
Study a new technical concept the way you'd study an opponent's tactics, while holding a 15-second plank for core stability.

medium_quests.description: Jog 1 easy kilometer at a light training pace, then read 5 pages to build up your football IQ off the pitch.
Grind out 10 clean push-ups, then write a basic Python script using a loop. Think of it as drilling repetitions for your brain.
Organize your setup for 10 minutes like prepping your boots and kit bag, then power through 15 deep bodyweight squats.
Complete a 5-minute typing drill for sharp reflexes, then hold a solid 45-second plank like you're braced for a tackle.
Map out your day like a coach setting a game plan, then complete 5 bodyweight rows or 1 pull-up.

higher_quest.description: Run 2.5 kilometers at a steady match-fitness pace, then read 15 pages, jotting notes like a scout breaking down a game.
Lock in for a 25-minute uninterrupted focus block, then finish with 20 push-ups to build upper-body power for holding off defenders.
Build a simple terminal utility, maybe one that tracks your football stats, then knock out 3 strict pull-ups.
Cycle for 20 minutes to build engine and stamina, then write a 250-word reflection on a match, book, or project.
Solve a logic puzzle to sharpen your decision-making under pressure, then finish with 30 deep squats.

exceptional_quests.description: Run 4 kilometers non-stop, matching a full match's worth of distance covered, then read 30 pages to round out the day.
Complete 30 clean push-ups like closing out a hard training session, then write a structured 500-word essay on a topic you care about.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Build Interactive Todo Web App + 2-Min Plank
exceptional_quests.description: Build a functional To-Do web app, maybe to track your quests, and hold a 2-minute plank to close it out like extra time.
Run a full 25-minute bodyweight circuit like a preseason conditioning session, then finish an entire chapter to keep your mind sharp.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Prep Healthy Meals + Organize Digital Files
exceptional_quests.description: Prep meals like a pro fueling for matchday, then restructure your digital files as if organizing your season's game footage.

tekkers.desc: Specializes in tech: quick feet on the keyboard, sharp on the ball, precise with the code.

lower_quests.description: Learn one new keyboard shortcut, a quick trick to shave off touches, just like a slick one-touch pass.
Scout a web page under the hood using dev tools, the way an analyst breaks down an opponent's setup.

medium_quests.description: Write a working script with a variable, an if-statement, and a loop. Build your play like stringing together a passing sequence.
Solve a beginner algorithm puzzle, reading the pattern the way a midfielder reads a passing lane.
Code a clean web card component, styled as sharp as a well-kept kit: clean lines, no sloppy touches.
Stage and commit your changes with a clear message, locking in progress like a match result on the scoresheet.
Write a structured README with headers and lists, like drawing up a clear matchday team sheet.

higher_quest.quest_name: Write Python Function with Error Handling
higher_quest.description: Write a multi-argument function with try/except blocks, covering your defense against bad inputs like a well-organized backline.

higher_quest.quest_name: Build a Simple Terminal CLI Utility
higher_quest.description: Build a CLI tool that takes flags and processes data, maybe something to crunch your own football stats.

higher_quest.quest_name: Fetch & Parse Data from a Public API
higher_quest.description: Pull data from a public API (try a football stats API) and display clean, parsed results like a live match feed.
Initialize a repo and push your commits to GitHub, building your season's transfer record for the world to see.

higher_quest.quest_name: Build a Basic Interactive Web Page
higher_quest.description: Add click handlers that update the page dynamically, as reactive as a keeper adjusting position to the ball.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Build a Complete To-Do List Web App
exceptional_quests.description: Build a full To-Do app with add, edit, and delete, like managing your own squad depth chart.
Write a script that automatically sorts your Downloads by file type, keeping your digital locker room as tidy as your kit bag.
Connect a frontend to a live weather API and build a dashboard, handy for checking pitch conditions before matchday.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Set Up a Local SQLite Database
exceptional_quests.description: Create tables, insert rows, and query with SQL, like building your own player database from scratch.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Write Unit Tests covering a Python Module
exceptional_quests.description: Write 5 test cases to verify your functions, running quality checks the way a coach reviews match footage.

playmaker.desc: Vision and the read of the game: reading the pitch starts with reading the page.

lower_quests.description: Read two pages to break through the early friction, like the first few touches to settle into a match.
Pick out and underline the single most important idea on the page, like spotting the key pass in a build-up.
Look up a new word you don't know, expanding your vocabulary the way a player expands their range of passes.
Scan the table of contents to map the book's shape, the way you'd study a formation before kickoff.
Sum up what you just read in one sharp sentence, as clean and decisive as a one-touch finish.

medium_quests.quest_name: Read 10 Pages of an Educational Book
medium_quests.description: Read 10 pages straight through, keeping your focus locked in like tracking the ball for a full half.
Boil a section down to three clear sentences, like summing up a match in a quick post-game recap.
Find and learn three new words with example sentences, adding fresh tools to your vocabulary like new moves to your game.
Turn key concepts into 5 flashcards, drilling recall the way you'd drill set pieces on the training pitch.
Read a full 1,000-word article start to finish, showing the same patience it takes to build an attack from the back.

higher_quest.description: Read 25 pages straight through, highlighting the big arguments like circling the key moments of a match.
Write a short critique of a chapter's claims, breaking it down like a pundit dissecting a tactical decision.

higher_quest.quest_name: Read 1 Full Chapter & Take Bulleted Notes
higher_quest.description: Read a full chapter and note the main thesis in bullets, structured like a coach's pre-match briefing.
Write a comparison of two articles' perspectives, weighing them like comparing two rival tactical systems.

higher_quest.quest_name: Create 15 Study Flashcards for a Topic
higher_quest.description: Build a 15-card flashcard deck on one topic, drilling the fundamentals until they're second nature, like touch and control.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Read 50 Pages of a Book in One Day
exceptional_quests.description: Read 50 pages across the day, pacing yourself like a midfielder managing energy over 90 minutes.

exceptional_quests.quest_name: Write a 500-Word Essay Review of a Book
exceptional_quests.description: Write a 500-word review breaking down a book's arguments and impact, like a full match analysis after the final whistle.
Finish an entire short non-fiction book, closing it out the way you'd see out a hard-fought result.
Break a full book down chapter-by-chapter into a reference guide, mapping it out like a full season's tactical playbook.
Compile and review 30 flashcards on a full subject, building a deep playbook of knowledge like a seasoned playmaker's range of passes.

defender.desc: Incredibly physical: running, lifting, grinding through anything that takes muscle, like a rock at the back.

lower_quests.description: Do one easy lap, the kind of light jog a defender does to warm up before shifting into game speed.
Perform 5 slow, controlled squats, building the leg strength that powers a strong tackle or jump for a header.
Hold a 15-second plank, the kind of core stability that keeps you balanced under a physical challenge.
Do 3 incline push-ups to start building the upper-body strength you need to hold off a striker's back-to-goal play.
Get 10 brisk jumping jacks in to raise your heart rate, just like the first sprint of a warm-up drill.

medium_quests.description: Jog 1.5 kilometers at a relaxed pace, building the aerobic base that lets a defender track runners for 90 minutes.
Perform 10 standard push-ups to build the upper-body strength that wins physical duels in the box.
Do 15 bodyweight squats to parallel depth, sharpening the leg power behind every jump and tackle.
Hold a 45-second plank, keeping your core as solid as a well-organized defensive line.
Perform 10 walking lunges, training the same explosive stride length a fullback uses to close down space.

higher_quest.description: Run 3 kilometers at a steady pace, building the engine that lets you cover ground box-to-box all match.
Complete 20 strict push-ups, forging the upper-body strength to win aerial duels and shrug off contact.
Perform 30 continuous squats, building the explosive power behind every jump for a header.
Hold a 90-second plank without sagging, the kind of core resilience that holds a defensive shape under pressure.
Complete 3 pull-ups or 10 bodyweight rows, adding the pulling strength that helps you win the ball in a shoulder-to-shoulder battle.

exceptional_quests.description: Run 5 kilometers non-stop, matching the kind of distance a box-to-box player covers over a full match.
Accumulate 35 strict push-ups across a session, the grind that builds a defender's physical edge.
Perform 50 bodyweight squats in one session, putting in the leg work behind every last-ditch tackle.
Accumulate 3 total minutes in plank position, building the kind of core endurance that holds firm deep into extra time.
Complete a full 25-minute circuit of push-ups, squats, lunges, and planks, a full preseason-style conditioning session.
